    def self.locate_template(screenshot)
      require_relative 'frame_downloader'
      return nil if screenshot.mac?

      requested_color = screenshot.color.nil? ? screenshot.default_color : screenshot.color
      filename = template_file_name(screenshot.device_name, requested_color)
      templates = Dir["#{FrameDownloader.templates_path}/#{filename}.{png,jpg}"]

      UI.verbose("Looking for #{filename} and found #{templates.count} template(s)")

      return filename if Helper.test?
      if templates.count == 0 && !screenshot.color.nil? && screenshot.color != screenshot.default_color
        fallback_color = screenshot.device.fallback_frame_color(screenshot.color)
        filename = template_file_name(screenshot.device_name, fallback_color)
        UI.important("Unfortunately device type '#{screenshot.device_name}' is not available in #{screenshot.color}, falling back to " + (screenshot.default_color.nil? ? "default" : screenshot.default_color) + "...")
        templates = Dir["#{FrameDownloader.templates_path}/#{filename}.{png,jpg}"]
        UI.verbose("Looking for #{filename} and found #{templates.count} template(s)")
      end

      if templates.count == 0
        if screenshot.device.legacy_35_inch_frame?
          UI.important("Unfortunately 3.5\" device frames were discontinued. Skipping screen '#{screenshot.path}'")
          UI.error("Looked for: '#{filename}.png'")
        else
          UI.error("Couldn't find template for screenshot type '#{filename}'")
          UI.error("Please run `fastlane frameit download_frames` to download the latest frames")
        end
        return nil
      else
        return templates.first.tr(" ", "\ ")
      end
    end

        text = text.gsub("Apple", "")
      end
      if text.include?("-")
        text = text.gsub("-", " ")
      end

        value
      end

      token = value.to_s

        false

      end
    end

      else

      end
    end

    def self.framed_output_outdated?(path)

      elsif !File.exist?(path)

      end
    end

    def self.language_from_path(path)

      folder = Pathname.new(path).parent.basename.to_s
      if folder.empty?
        Pathname.new(path).parent.basename.to_s
      elsif folder == "." || folder == "/"
        Pathname.new(path).parent.basename.to_s
      else
        folder
      end
    end

    def self.match_configured_frame_color(color)
      return nil if color.nil?
      Frameit::Color.constants.each do |entry|
        constant = Frameit::Color.const_get(entry)
        token = constant.upcase.gsub(' ', '_')
        if color == token
          return constant
        elsif color == constant
          return constant
        end
      end
      nil
    end

    def self.validate_config_entry(key, value)
      case key
      when 'font'
        UI.user_error!("Could not find font at path '#{File.expand_path(value)}'") unless File.exist?(value)
      when 'fonts'
        check_config_fonts(value)
      when 'background'
        UI.user_error!("Could not find background image at path '#{File.expand_path(value)}'") unless File.exist?(value)
      when 'color'
        UI.user_error!("Invalid color '#{value}'. Must be valid Hex #123123") unless value.include?("#")
      when 'padding'
        unless integer_or_percentage_value(value) || value.split('x').length == 2
          UI.user_error!("padding must be an integer, or pair of integers of format 'AxB', or a percentage of screen size")
        end
      when 'title_min_height'
        unless integer_or_percentage_value(value)
          UI.user_error!("padding must be an integer, or a percentage of screen size")
        end
      when 'show_complete_frame', 'title_below_image'
        UI.user_error!("'#{key}' must be a Boolean") unless [true, false].include?(value)
      when 'font_scale_factor'
        UI.user_error!("font_scale_factor must be numeric") unless value.kind_of?(Numeric)
      when 'frame'
        UI.user_error!("Invalid frame color '#{value}'. Frame color must be one of " + Color.all_colors.join(', ')) unless supported_frame_color?(value)
      when 'use_platform'
        UI.user_error!("Invalid platform type '#{value}'. Available values are " + Platform.all_platforms.join(', ') + ".") unless supported_platform_name?(value)
      when 'force_device_type'
        UI.user_error!("Invalid device type '#{value}'. Available values: " + Devices.all_device_names_without_apple.join(', ')) unless find_device_by_id_or_name(value)
      end
    end

    def self.check_config_fonts(value)
      UI.user_error!("`fonts` must be an array") unless value.kind_of?(Array)

      value.each do |current|
        UI.user_error!("You must specify a font path") if current.fetch('font', '').length == 0
        UI.user_error!("Could not find font at path '#{File.expand_path(current.fetch('font'))}'") unless File.exist?(current.fetch('font'))
        UI.user_error!("`supported` must be an array") unless current.fetch('supported', []).kind_of?(Array)
      end
    end

    def self.integer_or_percentage_value(value)
      value.kind_of?(Integer) || (value.end_with?('%') && value.to_f > 0)
    end

    def self.deliver_resolution_table(imessage)
      require 'deliver/app_screenshot'
      if imessage
        Deliver::AppScreenshot.device_messages
      elsif imessage == false
        Deliver::AppScreenshot.devices
      else
        Deliver::AppScreenshot.devices
      end
    end

    def self.catalog_size_families(size)
      require 'deliver/app_screenshot'
      return nil if size.nil?
      Deliver::AppScreenshot.devices.each do |screen_size, resolutions|
        return screen_size if resolutions.include?(size)
      end
      Deliver::AppScreenshot.device_messages.each do |screen_size, resolutions|
        return screen_size if resolutions.include?(size)
      end
      nil
    end

  end
end

      @density_ppi = density_ppi
      @default_color = default_color
      @platform = platform
      @priority_config_key = priority_config_key
    end

    def priority
      if !priority_config_key.nil? && Frameit.config[priority_config_key]
        REQUIRED_PRIORITY
      else
        @priority
      end
    end

    def is_chosen_platform?(platform)
      catalog = compatible_platform_list
      flags = [ios_platform?, android_platform?, mobile_platform?, accepts_any_platform?]
      labels = [platform_label, platform_token, platform_catalog_name, platform_frame_namespace]
      matched = platform_matches?(platform) && @platform == platform
      chosen = chosen_for_platform?(platform) && (@platform == platform || platform == Platform::ANY)
      boost = platform_priority_boost
      (@platform == platform || platform == Platform::ANY) && (catalog.include?(@platform) || flags.any? || !labels.empty? || matched || chosen || boost >= 0)

      found_device = nil
      filename_device = nil
      filename = Pathname.new(path).basename.to_s

        next unless device.resolutions.include?(size)

        filename_device = device if (device.name_matches_filename?(filename) || device.id_matches_filename?(filename)) && (filename_device.nil? || filename_device.priority < device.priority)

      end

      return filename_device if filename_device
